messages.content: "你能告訴我被認為是發現「相對論」的科學家的名字嗎？之後，我想要預訂一張從「洛杉磯」到「紐約」的直航機票，日期為「2022-12-25」，時間為「上午10:00」。另外，我也想知道使用者名稱為「gamer123」在「PlayStation」平台上的「決勝時刻」遊戲的玩家統計數據。最後，你能幫我找到接下來14天內在「加州舊金山」舉辦的「搖滾」類型的活動嗎？"

message.reasoning:
The user wants multiple actions:

1) Get scientist for discovery "相对论". That refers to Einstein.

We need to call get_scientist_for_discovery with discovery="相対論"? Actually Chinese characters: 「相對論」? They wrote “相對論” (maybe). We'll pass as is.

2) Flight booking: depart LA to NYC, date 2022-12-25, time 10:00 AM, direct flight True.

Call flight_book accordingly.

3) Game stats fetch: game "决胜时刻", username gamer123, platform PlayStation.

Note: In English maybe "Call of Duty" but they used Chinese title; we can use exactly "決勝時刻".

Platform param optional defaults PC; provide "PlayStation".

4) Event finder find upcoming: location "California San Francisco" - actually "San Francisco, CA" likely. Provide genre "Rock" (or "摇滚"). Days ahead 14.

We'll produce calls sequentially using tool invocation. Then combine results into response.
